summary: Until Long Rest, gain one use each of Misty Step, Enhance Leap and Blur.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain one use each of Misty Step, Enhance Leap and Blur.
fields.Acquisition: Trade githyanki blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Misty Step: Bonus Action. Teleport up to 60 ft to a visible unoccupied space.
fields.Enhance Leap: Action at melee range. Triple jump distance for 10 turns.
fields.Blur: Action on yourself, concentration up to 10 turns. Attackers who rely on sight and cannot see through illusions have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
